title: Finite generation of coherent twisted section tails on standard Proj
statement: Let $S=\bigoplus_{d\ge0}S_d$ be a nonnegatively graded commutative ring such that $S_0$ is Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and $S$ is generated as an $S_0$-algebra by finitely many elements of $S_1$. Put $X=\operatorname{Proj}(S)$ [def-pc-proj]. Then $X$ is a Noetherian scheme, meaning that it admits a finite affine open covering with Noetherian coordinate rings [pqf-def-locnoeth]. For every coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal F$ [pqf-def-coherent], put $\mathcal F(n)=\mathcal F\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\mathcal O_X(n)$, where $\mathcal O_X(n)=\widetilde{S(n)}$ [def-weil-pbc-proj-twisting-sheaf, def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. The nonnegative graded $S$-module $N_{\ge0}=\bigoplus_{n\ge0}\Gamma(X,\mathcal F(n))$, with the action of $s\in S_e$ given by multiplication by its canonical section of $\mathcal O_X(e)$ through [lem-sfb-standard-proj-twist-tensor], is finitely generated as an $S$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. The assertion allows $X=\varnothing$ and $\mathcal F=0$.

source.place: Tag 0AG6, lemma-coherent-on-proj, opening Noetherian assertion and part (4), specialized to k=0; the proof reduces to 01YS, lemma-coherent-projective.

proof.text: Put $R=S_0$. Choose degree-one algebra generators $s_0,\ldots,s_r$, padding with zeros so that $r\ge1$. Sending $T_j$ to $s_j$ gives a surjective graded map $\psi:C=R[T_0,\ldots,T_r]\twoheadrightarrow S$. The opens $D_+(s_j)$ cover $X$: a homogeneous prime containing all $s_j$ contains every positive-degree monomial, hence $S_+$, so is not a point of Proj. The empty Proj has the empty affine cover and its section module is zero; the subsequent argument also permits this case. Apply the surjective-map clause of [prop-nagata-relative-proj-functoriality] over $\operatorname{Spec}R$ to obtain the closed immersion $i:X\hookrightarrow P=\mathbf P^r_R$.

source.place: Tag 0AG6, lemma-coherent-on-proj, reduction to projective space; Tag 01YS, lemma-coherent-projective, proof of (5)

proof.text: By [lem-weil-pbc-proj-polynomial-twist-chart], the finitely many standard charts of $P$ have rings $R[T_l/T_j:l\ne j]$. By [lem-sfb-graded-proj-quotient-twist-comparison], their inverse images are the standard affine charts $D_+(s_j)$, and the maps to their coordinate rings are surjective. The chart rings of $P$ and $X$ are therefore finite type $R$-algebras, so are Noetherian by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra-noetherian]. This proves the asserted finite Noetherian affine cover of $X$ and also that $P$ is Noetherian.

source.place: Tag 0AG6, lemma-coherent-on-proj, reduction to projective space; Tag 01YS, lemma-coherent-projective, proof of (5)

proof.text: Put $G=i_*\mathcal F$. The closed-immersion theorem [lem-pc-closed-immersion-coherent-cohomology] makes $G$ coherent and gives the natural projection isomorphisms $G\otimes\mathcal O_P(d)\cong i_*(\mathcal F\otimes i^*\mathcal O_P(d))$. The twists here agree with the shifted-module twists: on $D_+(T_j)$, the basis $T_j^d$ of $(C_{T_j})_d$ satisfies $T_j^d=(T_j/T_l)^dT_l^d$, precisely the transition rule of [def-pc-projective-space-twist]. The comparison [lem-sfb-graded-proj-quotient-twist-comparison] identifies the pullback with $\mathcal O_X(d)$. Taking sections therefore gives isomorphisms $H^0(P,G(d))\cong H^0(X,\mathcal F(d))$. They commute with multiplication by every $c\in C_e$: the projection map takes a local tensor $g\otimes t$ to $g\otimes i^*t$, and the comparison takes $i^*c$ to $\psi(c)$ and respects tensor multiplication. Thus $M=\bigoplus_{d\ge0}H^0(P,G(d))$ is identified with $N_{\ge0}=\bigoplus_{d\ge0}\Gamma(X,\mathcal F(d))$ restricted from $S$ to $C$ via $\psi$.

source.place: Tag 0AG6, lemma-coherent-on-proj, reduction to projective space; Tag 01YS, lemma-coherent-projective, proof of (5)

proof.text: By [lem-pc-projective-space-twist-quotient] choose $m_j\ge0$ and a short exact sequence $0\to K\to E=\bigoplus_j\mathcal O_P(-m_j)\to G\to0$ with $K$ coherent. Tensor with $\mathcal O_P(d)$; exactness follows from [lem-sc-ext-tensor-exact], because this twist is locally free of rank one by [def-pc-projective-space-twist]. By [lem-pc-twist-tensor] the middle term becomes $E(d)=\bigoplus_j\mathcal O_P(d-m_j)$. The long exact sequence of [pqf-def-cohomology] contains $H^0(P,E(d))\to H^0(P,G(d))\to H^1(P,K(d))$. By [lem-pc-projective-space-serre-vanishing] choose $b\ge0$ such that the final term is zero for every $d\ge b$. Consequently the first map is surjective in each such degree. These maps respect multiplication by homogeneous polynomials, since they are induced by the fixed module morphism $E\to G$ tensored with the twists and the canonical multiplication isomorphisms.

source.place: Tag 0AG6, lemma-coherent-on-proj, reduction to projective space; Tag 01YS, lemma-coherent-projective, proof of (5)

proof.text: Since $r\ge1$, the monomial calculation [lem-pc-projective-space-twist-cohomology] identifies $H^0(P,\mathcal O_P(d-m_j))$ with $C_{d-m_j}$, with negative polynomial degrees zero. This identification respects multiplication: on $D_+(T_l)$ a polynomial section $a$ has coefficient $a/T_l^{d-m_j}$ in the twist basis, and multiplying by $c\in C_e$ multiplies that coefficient by $c/T_l^e$. Hence $Q=\bigoplus_{d\ge0}H^0(P,E(d))$ is the finite graded free module $\bigoplus_j C(-m_j)$, generated by the unit in degree $m_j$. The ring $C$ is Noetherian by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra-noetherian]. The tail $Q_{\ge b}$ is a $C$-submodule (all polynomial degrees are nonnegative), and is finite by [lem-weil-pbc-noetherian-submodule-finite]. The degreewise surjections of the preceding step assemble to $Q_{\ge b}\twoheadrightarrow M_{\ge b}$. Images of a finite generating set generate the image, so $M_{\ge b}$ is finite.

source.place: Tag 0AG6, lemma-coherent-on-proj, reduction to projective space; Tag 01YS, lemma-coherent-projective, proof of (5)

proof.text: For each $0\le d<b$, the twist $G(d)$ is coherent: locally its invertible tensor factor is the structure sheaf, so it is locally isomorphic to $G$; use [def-pc-projective-space-twist] and the local definition [pqf-def-coherent]. By [lem-pc-projective-space-coherent-finiteness], $H^0(P,G(d))$ is a finite $R$-module. Choose finite $R$-generators in these finitely many degrees, viewed as homogeneous elements of $M$, and add a finite $C$-generating set of $M_{\ge b}$. Every element of the direct sum has finitely many components: its components below $b$ are $R$-linear combinations of the chosen low generators, and its remaining part is in the high tail. This finite union therefore generates $M$ over $C$. For $b=0$ the low set is empty. Since the isomorphism of step 3 makes the $C$-action factor through $\psi:C\twoheadrightarrow S$, the same finite set generates $N_{\ge0}$ over $S$: each expression $\sum c_jv_j$ is $\sum\psi(c_j)v_j$. For $\mathcal F=0$ or $X=\varnothing$ the empty set suffices.

(5) H^0(O(d-m_j)) = C_{d-m_j} for r>=1, so Q is finite free and Q_{>=b} is finite over Noetherian C. (6) Coherent low twists have finite H^0 over R, which gives finite generation over C and then over S through psi; b=0, F=0 and X empty are covered. lean.statement: theorem standardProjCoherentSectionFiniteness {S : Type u} [CommRing S] (𝒜 : ℕ → AddSubgroup S) [GradedRing 𝒜] [IsNoetherianRing (𝒜 0)] (hgen : ∃ (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → S), (∀ i : Fin r, f i ∈ 𝒜 1) ∧ Algebra.adjoin (𝒜 0) (Set.range f) = ⊤) : IsNoetherian (Proj 𝒜) ∧ ∀ (F : (Proj 𝒜).Modules), Scheme.Modules.IsQuasiCoherentFiniteType F → ∃ m : Module S (⨁ n : ℕ, Γ(F ⊗ twist 𝒜 (n : ℤ), ⊤)), (∀ (e n : ℕ) (s : S) (hs : s ∈ 𝒜 e) (t : Γ(F ⊗ twist 𝒜 (n : ℤ), ⊤)), @SMul.smul S (⨁ k : ℕ, Γ(F ⊗ twist 𝒜 (k : ℤ), ⊤)) m.toSMul s (DirectSum.of (fun k : ℕ ↦ Γ(F ⊗ twist 𝒜 (k : ℤ), ⊤)) n t) = DirectSum.of (fun k : ℕ ↦ Γ(F ⊗ twist 𝒜 (k : ℤ), ⊤)) (n + e) (Hom.app ((F ◁ twistMul (n : ℤ) hs) ≫ eqToHom (congrArg (fun z : ℤ ↦ F ⊗ twist 𝒜 z) (Int.natCast_add n e).symm)) ⊤ t)) ∧ @Module.Finite S (⨁ n : ℕ, Γ(F ⊗ twist 𝒜 (n : ℤ), ⊤)) _ _ m
lean.note: The direct sum is the existing Mathlib direct sum of the actual tensor-twisted global-section groups. The existential Module structure is uniquely specified on every homogeneous scalar and every component by the existing twistMul; no arbitrary action is assumed. Finite generation is asserted for exactly this structure. Coherence uses the unchanged recorded IsQuasiCoherentFiniteType predicate: on the Noetherian Proj of this assertion it is equivalent to coherence by Stacks 01XZ.
